mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant BZ as Bergzicht Outdoor
    participant VAN as the EDI provider
    participant IP as the iPaaS
    participant OMS as the OMS
    participant AV as the availability service
    participant ERP as the ERP
    participant WMS as the WMS
    BZ->>VAN: ORDERS, 240 units, 18 lines, 6 April
    VAN-->>BZ: CONTRL acknowledgement
    VAN->>IP: Interchange for Kestrel and Pine
    IP->>OMS: Mapped order with PO reference
    OMS->>ERP: Check contract prices and credit limit
    ERP-->>OMS: Prices match, limit not exceeded
    OMS->>AV: Allocate 240 units at Duiven
    AV-->>OMS: Committed
    OMS->>VAN: ORDRSP accepted, delivery 9 April
    OMS->>WMS: Fulfillment order, pallet service level
    WMS-->>OMS: Accepted
    WMS->>WMS: Pick, pack to three pallets, print SSCC labels
    WMS->>VAN: DESADV from pack confirmation, 8 April
    VAN-->>BZ: DESADV with three SSCCs
    WMS-->>OMS: Shipped, three pallets
    BZ->>BZ: Scan SSCCs at Zwolle, 9 April
    OMS->>ERP: Shipped lines and prices
    ERP->>VAN: INVOIC, due 9 May
    VAN-->>BZ: INVOIC
    BZ-->>ERP: Bank transfer and remittance, by 9 May

flowchart LR
    ORD["ORDERS from Bergzicht"] -->|"mapped and validated"| OMS["OMS order record"]
    OMS -->|"fulfillment order"| WMS["WMS pack confirmation with SSCCs"]
    WMS -->|"DESADV"| REC["Receipt scan at Zwolle"]
    OMS -->|"shipped lines and prices"| ERP["ERP invoice INVOIC"]
    ERP -->|"receivable due 9 May"| PAY["Bank transfer and remittance"]
    PAY -->|"cash application"| ERP
    REC -.->|"four-way match on the buyer side"| ERP

flowchart TB
    subgraph JAN["January 2027"]
        O1["ORDERS into the ERP"] --> E1["ERP sends order to WMS"]
        E1 --> W1["WMS packs and prints its own labels"]
        O1 --> D1["DESADV from the ERP at release"]
        W1 -.->|"no link"| D1
        D1 --> X1["Scan mismatch at Zwolle, deduction"]
    end
    subgraph LATE["Late 2027 after W6"]
        O2["ORDERS into the OMS"] --> W2["WMS packs and prints SSCC at pack"]
        W2 --> D2["DESADV from pack confirmation"]
        D2 --> X2["Scan matches, no deduction"]
    end
